keyPoints.en: "Daulat" links the ruler with the highest authority.
Today sovereignty is held under the Constitution.
keyPoints.bm: Kini kedaulatan dipegang di bawah Perlembagaan.

meaning.en: Supreme power of a Malay ruler.

question.en: When did Malaya regain full sovereignty?
question.bm: Bila Tanah Melayu memperoleh kedaulatan penuh?

tip.en: Define the term before giving examples.

keyPoints.en: A state needs people, territory, government and recognition.
keyPoints.bm: Negara memerlukan rakyat, wilayah, kerajaan dan pengiktirafan.

keyPoints.en: Flag, anthem and laws are its symbols and tools.
keyPoints.bm: Bendera, lagu kebangsaan dan undang-undang ialah simbol dan alatnya.

tip.en: Give a Malaysian example per feature.
tip.bm: Beri contoh Malaysia bagi setiap ciri.

keyPoints.en: It gives freedom in laws, economy and foreign policy.
keyPoints.bm: Ia memberi kebebasan dalam undang-undang, ekonomi dan dasar luar.

keyPoints.en: It protects people and national identity.
keyPoints.bm: Ia melindungi rakyat dan identiti negara.

keyPoints.en: Defence, law and diplomacy protect the state.
keyPoints.bm: Pertahanan, undang-undang dan diplomasi melindungi negara.

keyPoints.en: Citizens play a part through unity and loyalty.
keyPoints.bm: Rakyat berperanan melalui perpaduan dan kesetiaan.
